memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Do not eat anything you find already dead. You may give it to the foreigner residing in any of your towns, and they may eat it, or you may sell it to any other foreigner. But you are a people holy to the Lord your God. Do not cook a young goat in its mother's milk. - Deut 14:21 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
This verse gathers several instructions and grounds them in a single reason: "you are a people holy to the Lord your God." Even in matters as small as what meat to eat or how to prepare a meal, Israel was to remember their holy calling. The strange-sounding command not to cook a goat in its mother's milk likely distanced Israel from a pagan ritual practice of the surrounding cultures. In all these details, the point was the same: God's people were set apart, and even small things reflected their belonging to Him.

The recurring phrase "you are a people holy to the Lord" is the thread running through this whole chapter. Holiness means being set apart for God, and it was to touch every part of life, down to the smallest domestic detail. God cared not only about the grand acts of worship but about the ordinary choices of daily living. Nothing was too small to reflect their devotion to Him.

These particular ceremonial rules do not bind believers today; we are free in Christ. But the truth that we are called to holiness in small things remains. "Be holy, because I am holy," God says, and Peter applies this directly to Christians (1 Pet 1:15-16). Holiness is not just for the big moments; it shows up in the small, unseen choices — how we speak when no one is listening, how we handle little temptations, how we treat people who can do nothing for us. God is honored in the details. Ask Him to make you holy not just in the great things but in the small, ordinary faithfulness of everyday life.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do I think of holiness only in big moments, or also in small daily choices?
- Where are the "small things" in my life that reflect my devotion to God?
- How can I pursue faithfulness in the unseen, ordinary details?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, You call me to be holy as You are holy, and that holiness touches even the smallest things. Help me honor You in the unseen details — my words, my little choices, my everyday faithfulness. Set me apart for You in all of life, great and small. Amen.
